issuer: the Department for Infrastructure and Transport (Service SA)
note: Read 2026-10-31 in archive.org's snapshots of the Department for Infrastructure and Transport's own pages on sa.gov.au (which answers this egress with a Cloudflare challenge). 'Apply for your provisional licence (P's)', snapshot of 7 January 2026 (page last updated 15 December 2025): a provisional licence is had from at least 17, after 12 months on the learner's permit for those 17 to 24; it is valid for 3 years, P1 for 1 year and P2 for 2; a renewal notice is posted before the P2 licence expires, and the full licence is got by renewing. From is my reading: 17 plus the provisional licence's 3 years. The fee is null: the 'Licence renewal fees' page that holds the full licence's fees (snapshot of 30 September 2025, page last updated 28 September 2023: $75 for 1 year to $570 for 10 years, concession $47 to $290) is older than SA's yearly fee changes (search snippets of the live page show higher figures, $302 and $592 for 10 years, on the blocked domain), and no later snapshot exists in the archive's index, so its figures aren't written.
